datasets.name: listings
queryLines:
SELECT
  property_id, source, city, property_type, neighborhood, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, url, INITCAP(city) AS city_label,
  first_seen_date, last_seen_date, days_seen,
  price_cop, last_price_cop, price_per_m2, area_m2,
  COALESCE(CAST(estrato AS STRING), 'unknown') AS estrato_label,
  CASE WHEN bedrooms IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN bedrooms >= 5 THEN '5+' ELSE CAST(bedrooms AS STRING) END AS bedrooms_label,
  CASE WHEN last_seen_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS still_listed,
  LEAST(price_cop / 1e6, 30) AS price_millions_capped,
  CASE WHEN area_m2 <= 400 AND price_cop <= 30e6 THEN area_m2 END AS area_m2_chart,
  CASE WHEN area_m2 <= 400 AND price_cop <= 30e6 THEN price_cop / 1e6 END AS price_millions_chart,
  CASE WHEN good_deal THEN 'Good deals only' ELSE 'Other listings' END AS deal_filter,
  CASE WHEN good_deal THEN 'Good deal' ELSE '' END AS deal_label, predicted_price_cop,
  sector_code, barrio,
  CASE WHEN city = 'bogota' THEN shape END AS shape_bogota,
  CASE WHEN city <> 'bogota' THEN shape END AS shape_aburra
FROM gold_rent_listings
-- Daily model price and good-deal flag (score.py). Only listings seen in the last 7 days are scored.
LEFT JOIN (SELECT source AS deal_source, property_id AS deal_id, good_deal, predicted_price_cop
    FROM rent_predictions) d
  ON d.deal_source = source AND d.deal_id = property_id
-- Barrio of each neighborhood name in its city, and its outline (locate.py, daily).
-- Outlines are simplified to about 10 m so the maps load fast.
LEFT JOIN (SELECT city AS loc_city, neighborhood AS loc_neighborhood, sector_code FROM neighborhood_locations) loc
  ON loc.loc_city = city AND loc.loc_neighborhood = neighborhood
LEFT JOIN (SELECT city AS shape_city, sector_code AS shape_code, sector_name AS barrio,
    ST_Simplify(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(geojson), 0.0001) AS shape FROM barrio_shapes) s
  ON s.shape_city = city AND s.shape_code = loc.sector_code
ORDER BY last_seen_date DESC, first_seen_date DESC

datasets.name: vehicle_listings
queryLines:
SELECT
  listing_id, source, INITCAP(source) AS dealer, city, INITCAP(city) AS city_label,
  INITCAP(brand) AS brand_label, INITCAP(line) AS line_label, version, title,
  year, COALESCE(CAST(year AS STRING), 'unknown') AS year_label, km, engine_cc,
  COALESCE(INITCAP(transmission), 'Unknown') AS transmission_label,
  COALESCE(INITCAP(fuel), 'Unknown') AS fuel_label,
  COALESCE(INITCAP(body_type), 'Unknown') AS body_type_label,
  color, branch, url, first_seen_date, last_seen_date, days_seen, price_cop, last_price_cop,
  CASE WHEN last_seen_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS still_listed,
  LEAST(price_cop / 1e6, 400) AS price_millions_capped,
  CASE WHEN km <= 300000 AND price_cop <= 600e6 THEN km END AS km_chart,
  CASE WHEN km <= 300000 AND price_cop <= 600e6 THEN price_cop / 1e6 END AS price_millions_chart,
  CASE WHEN good_deal THEN 'Good deals only' ELSE 'Other cars' END AS deal_filter,
  CASE WHEN good_deal THEN 'Good deal' ELSE '' END AS deal_label, predicted_price_cop
FROM gold_vehicle_listings
-- Daily model price and good-deal flag (score.py --listings vehicle). Only cars seen in the last 7 days are scored.
LEFT JOIN (SELECT source AS deal_source, listing_id AS deal_id, good_deal, predicted_price_cop
    FROM vehicle_predictions) d
  ON d.deal_source = source AND d.deal_id = listing_id
ORDER BY last_seen_date DESC, first_seen_date DESC
